view:tokeninsights_data.analytics_confir:
SELECT facts.dataset_id,
    facts.fact_id,
    facts.scope,
    facts.harness,
    facts.session_id,
    facts.session_native_id,
    facts.message_native_id,
    facts.native_request_id,
    facts.occurred_at_ms,
    facts.provider,
    facts.provider_source,
    facts.model,
    facts.usage_scope,
    facts.quality,
    facts.countable,
    facts.input_tokens,
    facts.output_tokens,
    facts.reasoning_tokens,
    facts.cache_read_tokens,
    facts.cache_write_tokens,
    facts.total_tokens,
    facts.directory_key,
    facts.directory_name,
    facts.repository_key,
    facts.repository_name,
    facts.repository_source,
    facts.payload_json,
    facts.generation,
    facts.input_revision
   FROM (analytics_facts facts
     JOIN ingestion_metadata metadata ON (((metadata.dataset_id = facts.dataset_id) AND (metadata.generation = facts.generation))));
view:tokeninsights_data.analytics_estima:
SELECT estimates.dataset_id,
    estimates.fact_id,
    estimates.scope,
    estimates.harness,
    estimates.session_id,
    estimates.session_native_id,
    estimates.message_native_id,
    estimates.native_request_id,
    estimates.occurred_at_ms,
    estimates.provider,

    estimates.model,
    estimates.usage_scope,
    estimates.quality,
    estimates.countable,
    estimates.input_tokens,
    estimates.output_tokens,
    estimates.reasoning_tokens,
    estimates.cache_read_tokens,
    estimates.cache_write_tokens,
    estimates.total_tokens,
    estimates.directory_key,
    estimates.directory_name,
    estimates.repository_key,
